title: ARWP Agentic Web Protocol Observatory
scope: Public web, agent and commerce discovery mechanisms relevant to ARWP interoperability work.

methodology.review: Each row is reviewed against a primary specification or project source. Status describes the upstream mechanism, while arwpSupport describes only what ARWP currently implements.
methodology.historyPolicy: Previous snapshots are retained under /observatory/history/ rather than silently rewritten.

mechanisms.name: HTTP Web Linking / HTML link discovery
mechanisms.purpose: Advertise typed relationships between web resources, including alternate representations and discovery links.

mechanisms.name: llms.txt
mechanisms.purpose: Provide a concise LLM/agent-readable map of useful site content at a root or path-scoped llms.txt resource.
mechanisms.notes: The v2 proposal recommends rel=describedby for llms.txt and supports path-scoped files. It is not an authorization or tool protocol.

mechanisms.name: RFC 9727 API Catalog
mechanisms.purpose: Enable automated discovery of a publisher's public API catalog and endpoint metadata.

mechanisms.name: RFC 9728 OAuth Protected Resource Metadata
mechanisms.purpose: Publish OAuth protected-resource metadata, including authorization-server and resource capability information.
mechanisms.notes: Metadata describes authorization configuration; it does not grant access.

mechanisms.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
mechanisms.purpose: Connect AI applications with tool, resource and context providers through a common protocol.
discovery: evolving Server Card / AI Catalog metadata where published
mechanisms.notes: ARWP keeps static MCP metadata separate from runtime verification and never treats metadata as authorization.

mechanisms.name: Agent2Agent (A2A)
mechanisms.purpose: Enable communication, capability discovery and collaborative tasks between independent agent systems.
mechanisms.notes: An Agent Card describes identity, capabilities, skills, supported interfaces and security requirements. The card document URL is provenance, not automatically the callable endpoint.

mechanisms.name: Agent Skills
mechanisms.purpose: Package reusable agent instructions and resources in a skill directory whose required entry point is SKILL.md.
discovery: SKILL.md in a skill directory; client/product-specific discovery mechanisms
mechanisms.notes: The core public specification defines the SKILL.md format. ARWP's web-oriented agent-skills index discovery is an interoperability adapter/convention and must not be presented as part of the core Agent Skills specification unless upstream standardizes it.

mechanisms.name: WebMCP
mechanisms.purpose: Let web applications expose page-backed functionality as structured tools to browser agents and related consumers.
mechanisms.notes: A plain HTTP crawler cannot honestly prove a runtime-only WebMCP surface. ARWP plans an explicit opt-in browser inspector rather than inferring it from page text.

mechanisms.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)
mechanisms.purpose: Define programmatic commerce flows between buyers, AI agents and businesses, including checkout-oriented interaction.
discovery: merchant integration / protocol endpoints; discovery mechanisms remain ecosystem-specific
mechanisms.notes: Tracked for future transact-intent work (#37). ARWP does not currently claim ACP discovery support.

mechanisms.name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
mechanisms.purpose: Provide interoperable commerce capabilities and negotiation across consumer surfaces, businesses and payment providers.
discovery: UCP business/platform profiles and capability negotiation
mechanisms.notes: Tracked as an emerging transaction surface. ARWP does not currently claim UCP discovery or execution support.
